name: Commercial HVAC projects
tagline: Design, supply, install and maintain, all with one team
summary: Ducting, central systems and multi-unit projects for businesses.
description: For offices, showrooms, restaurants, clinics and industrial spaces, we handle complete HVAC packages: from choosing between ductable, package, VRV/VRF or chilled-water systems, to ducting, installation, commissioning and ongoing maintenance.
suitable_for: Offices, retail, hospitality, healthcare and industrial sites
includes: System selection based on load, layout and budget
GI ducting, grilles, diffusers and insulation
Ductable, package, VRV/VRF, AHU and chiller work
signs: You're fitting out a new office, showroom or restaurant
Existing cooling can't keep up with the space
You're replacing an old central system
You need fresh air or better indoor air quality

faqs.question: Do you provide drawings and BOQs?
faqs.answer: Yes. For projects we share the system layout and a bill of quantities with the proposal.

faqs.question: Can work happen outside business hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can schedule work at night or on weekends to avoid disrupting your business.
